changes: Introduced one shared safe mutation-scope containment helper used by both the trusted gate and managed cross-repository verifier.
Managed-project exact files and narrower subpatterns inside a central policy ceiling are accepted while traversal, sibling-prefix escape and unsupported widening remain fail-closed.
GitHub evidence verification now treats a certified CI run with run_attempt > 1 as objective recovery evidence and requires a valid append-only task recovery journal.
Recovery Guardian contracts now persist FAILURE_OBSERVED before retry authorization, RETRY_AUTHORIZED before redispatch/rerun, REPLAN before strategy change, and RECOVERED after success.
Added focused contract regressions for both generic gaps.
